##  {.section-heading}

Course Schedule

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

library(yaml)

schedule <- yaml::read_yaml("schedule.yml")

# -- icon helper: use <span> not <i> so Quarto won't convert to <em> --
fa <- function(name, extra_class = "") {
  cls <- paste0("fa-solid fa-", name)
  if (nzchar(extra_class)) cls <- paste(cls, extra_class)
  paste0('<span class="', cls, '"></span>')
}

# -- build icon-cell helper --
icon_cell <- function(url = NULL, title = "", icon, css_class = "") {
  if (is.null(url)) return('<td class="icon-cell"></td>')
  paste0(
    '<td class="icon-cell">',
    '<a class="content-link ', css_class, '" href="', url, '" title="', title, '">',
    fa(icon),
    '</a></td>'
  )
}

# -- start table --
cat('<table class="schedule-table">\n')
cat('<thead><tr>')
cat('<th style="width:6%">Week</th>')
cat('<th style="width:10%">Date</th>')
cat('<th style="width:40%">Topic</th>')
cat(paste0('<th style="width:15%; text-align:center">', fa("book-open-reader"), ' Content</th>'))
cat(paste0('<th style="width:15%; text-align:center">', fa("chalkboard"), ' Class</th>'))
cat(paste0('<th style="width:14%; text-align:center">', fa("pen-ruler"), ' Assign.</th>'))
cat('</tr></thead>\n<tbody>\n')

for (part in schedule) {
  # section divider
  cat(paste0(
    '<tr class="section-divider"><td colspan="6">',
    fa(part$section_icon), '&nbsp; ', part$section, '</td></tr>\n'
  ))

  for (w in part$weeks) {
    is_break <- isTRUE(w[["break"]])

    if (is_break) {
      cat(paste0(
        '<tr class="thanksgiving-row">',
        '<td class="week-num">', w$week, '</td>',
        '<td>', w$date, '</td>',
        '<td colspan="4">', fa(w$icon, "topic-icon"), '<em>', w$topic, '</em></td>',
        '</tr>\n'
      ))
    } else {
      assign_class <- if (isTRUE(w$milestone)) "milestone" else "assign"

      cat(paste0(
        '<tr>',
        '<td class="week-num">', w$week, '</td>',
        '<td>', w$date, '</td>',
        '<td>', fa(w$icon, "topic-icon"), w$topic, '</td>',
        icon_cell(w$content, w$content_title %||% "", "book-open-reader", ""),
        icon_cell(w$class, w$class_title %||% "", "chalkboard", ""),
        icon_cell(w$assign, w$assign_title %||% "", "pen-ruler", assign_class),
        '</tr>\n'
      ))
    }
  }
}

cat('</tbody></table>\n')
```
